thresholds.why: A tenth is where a holding stops being incidental and starts moving the equity. A half is where the company is better described by the holding than by its operations. Both are round numbers chosen for STABILITY of classification - see sensitivity() - and never for what it does to a backtest.

sensitivity.reading: a threshold in a flat region moves few companies. If a small shift moves many, the classification is an artefact of the threshold and the rule is not stable enough to publish.
